Notes: Portal Technician (POTN), Shadowlands portal ramp (playfield 4532). He charges the player for the portal (nano 239825) for credits in the Give Item window: 5000 for neutrals (retail text), 15000 for Clan and Omni (their lines are authored, not retail). Any other offer is refused.

how_to_use.Text: I'm geared to go! How do I use this portal?

lets_do_this_neutral.Text: Let's do this. What do you want for running the nano on me?

lets_do_this_clan.Text: Let's do this. What do you want for running the nano on me?

lets_do_this_omni.Text: Let's do this. What do you want for running the nano on me?

welcome.Text: Hello and welcome! Step right this way and you will be on your way to the Shadowlands in no time.

Text: It is very simple, first you pay a modest fee and I run a nano on you that will charge your body so the Shadowlands portal will function on you. Then you just walk into the swirling vortex out here on the ramp.
You will then materialize in Elysium in the Shadowlands.

price_neutral.Text: You neutrals are kindred spirits to us Jobeans, and I will let you pass for 5000 credits.{opentrade}

price_clan.Text: A Clanner, hm? Jobe stays out of your little war with Omni-Tek, but the portal still has to be paid for. For you it is 15000 credits.{opentrade}

price_omni.Text: Omni-Tek, I see. Your company can certainly afford it, and Jobe does not do favours for corporations. 15000 credits and you are on your way.{opentrade}
